name: Star Trek: Elite Force II
description: Star Trek: Elite Force II is a singleplayer and multiplayer first-person shooter game and the second in the Star Trek: Elite Force series.

audio_settings.title: Enable EAX
audio_settings.reason: Automatically enables EAX in Star Trek: Elite Force II's configuration. It also sets the sample rate to 44 kHz.

audio_settings.title: Enable stereo sound
audio_settings.reason: Sets Star Trek: Elite Force II's mixer to stereo sound.

audio_settings.title: Enable headphones
audio_settings.reason: Sets Star Trek: Elite Force II's mixer to headphones.

audio_settings.title: Enable Pro Logic surround sound
audio_settings.reason: Sets Star Trek: Elite Force II's mixer to Pro Logic surround sound.
audio_settings.follow_up: Don't forget to set your AV receiver or Soundbar to Dolby Pro Logic.

audio_settings.title: Enable 4.0 surround sound
audio_settings.reason: Sets Star Trek: Elite Force II's mixer to 4.0 surround sound.

audio_settings.title: Enable 5.1 surround sound
audio_settings.reason: Sets Star Trek: Elite Force II's mixer to 5.1 surround sound.

audio_settings.title: Enable 7.1 surround sound
audio_settings.reason: Sets Star Trek: Elite Force II's mixer to 7.1 surround sound.
